title: Generator Control Channel — Functional Test

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Functional test of one generator control channel, covering excitation, protection response and, on post modification aircraft, the ground inhibit behaviour with a door open.

sections.purpose: This task gives the functional test of one generator control channel after a unit installation, a configuration load or a protection related complaint. It confirms excitation, regulation and the protection responses, including the ground inhibit where it is embodied.
sections.job_setup_note: The aircraft must be on external power with both engines shut down. The test drives the channel through its protection thresholds, so the bay is live during the test and the access panel must be closed. Get the test set and confirm that the configuration standard reported by the unit is recorded before the test starts, because the expected results differ between the pre and post modification standards.
sections.procedure: 1. Close the access panel to the distribution bay and remove all tools from the area. 2. Restore external power and energise the channel. 3. Read and record the configuration standard reported by the unit. 4. Do the excitation check and confirm the voltage stays inside the tolerance band for sixty seconds. 5. Apply the simulated overtemperature input from the test set and confirm the channel sheds within the confirmation window stated for the configuration standard fitted. 6. WARNING: DO NOT OPEN THE BAY ACCESS PANEL DURING THE TEST. THE RACK CONNECTORS ARE LIVE. 7. Reset the channel and confirm it recovers. 8. On aircraft post MOD-168118, open one passenger door, apply the simulated overtemperature input again and confirm that no shed occurs and that a maintenance status is raised instead of a flight deck caution. 9. CAUTION: CLOSE THE DOOR AND CLEAR THE MAINTENANCE STATUS BEFORE YOU LEAVE THE AIRCRAFT. AN UNCLEARED STATUS WILL BE CARRIED INTO THE NEXT DISPATCH. 10. Do the same test on the second channel. 11. Print or export the test record from the maintenance terminal.
sections.close_out: Clear all maintenance messages raised by the test and confirm the flight deck is free of cautions. Remove external power if no further work is planned. File the test record with the aircraft documentation and enter the result in the technical log against the task.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; step 8 applies to aircraft post MOD-168118 only

safety_precautions: Close the bay access panel before the channel is energised.
Do not open the bay access panel during the test.
